# Event types

Generated from `internal/event.Types`. Types are added, not removed (docs/traceability.md, ARCHITECTURE.md §7).
#151 renamed the `identity.alias_*` pair to `identity.bound` and `identity.unbound`, once;
rows stored before it keep the old type.

Every event that records a model call carries its usage: `prompt_tokens` and
`completion_tokens` always (`0` when the upstream reported none), and
`cost_nanousd` (an integer of USD × 10⁻⁹, so sums are exact), `cached_tokens`
and `reasoning_tokens` only when the upstream reported them. Events stored
before `cost_nanousd` carry `cost`, a float in USD, read in its place. A call
without a cost is unpriced (a local engine, a subscription), never free; a
free model reports `0`. `unpriced_calls` is always written: how
many of the event's calls reported no cost, `0` or `1` for one call and more
for a sum (`browser.task.finished`, a scored `tool.result`, `run.finished`,
`browser.move`). A call that was not made — a cached guard verdict, a
failure before any reply — writes no usage at all; a reply that was
answered and then failed (a dropped stream on `model.error`, an empty
description on `media.refused`) still does. The totals of a trace and of a
session sum those attributes over the types marked *counted*
(`internal/event.UsageTypes`), each of which reports its calls exactly once;
`run.finished` and `browser.move` repeat numbers already counted and are left
out. A total's cost covers the priced calls; its `unpriced_calls` says how
many it does not cover.
